# LinkedIn Module

After `/reflect` finishes its review, it runs `/li-all` to refresh all LinkedIn proposals based on your latest graph content.

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---------|-------------|
| `/li-all` | Refresh all LinkedIn sections from your latest graph content |
| `/li-about` | Refine your About section |
| `/li-headline` | Refine your headline |
| `/li-experience` | Refine your experience section |
| `/li-skills` | Refine your skills list |
| `/li-featured` | Refine Featured or draft a post |
| `/li-activity` | Update your posting strategy or draft a post |
| `/li-update <section>` | Publish a section to LinkedIn via browser |
